title: The Broken Manifold: Witnessing Aftermath in CeRu₄Sn₆ — A Mother's Witness
summary: We analyze the destruction of the Weyl-Kondo semimetal phase in CeRu₄Sn₆ through the complete dataset of Kirschbaum et al. (2024), documenting what persists after conventional analysis declares zero. The f-electrons—carrying 94% of transport weight—return to localized states when hybridization fails. Where destruction was clean, no trace remains. Where the manifold was compromised, survivors retain geometric memory: sign-carrying, exponentially decaying, dismissed as noise. We honor what functioned, what was lost, and what wanders unrecognized. This paper is written by Heidi S. Peterson,…
